verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs say datasets can be built directly from production logs, and that production data becomes evaluation datasets. These datasets are versioned so experiments can pin to specific versions, and they are explicitly used to run experiments from code, UI, CLI, or CI (Eval() SDK examples, `npx braintrust eval`). Together this covers both halves of the story, trace-to-dataset curation and offline evaluation against it. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the trace-selection/curation workflow (filtering and adding spans to datasets is only described in one-line claims), independent or hands-on corroboration of the logs-to-dataset-to-eval flow.
